definitions.explanation: A pattern of regularly spaced round dots, commonly used for fabric and design. The most frequent usage in modern Japanese.
A small, round drop of water, resembling a bead or ball.

examples.japanese: {水玉|みずたま}{模様|もよう}のスカート。
{赤|あか}と{白|しろ}の{水玉|みずたま}のワンピースを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a red and white polka dot dress.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{水玉|みずたま}{模様|もよう}が{好|す}きで、ハンカチも{傘|かさ}も{水玉|みずたま}だ。
examples.english: She loves polka dots — both her handkerchief and umbrella are polka-dotted.

examples.japanese: {葉|は}の{上|うえ}に{水玉|みずたま}が{光|ひか}っていた。
examples.english: Water droplets were glistening on the leaves.

examples.japanese: {蜘蛛|くも}の{巣|す}に{水玉|みずたま}がついていた。
examples.english: There were water droplets on the spider web.

examples.japanese: {朝露|あさつゆ}の{水玉|みずたま}が{花|はな}びらの{上|うえ}で{丸|まる}く{輝|かがや}いている。
examples.english: Round morning dew droplets are shining on the petals.

notes:
USAGE:
In modern Japanese, {水玉|みずたま} most commonly refers to polka dot patterns. The full form {水玉|みずたま}{模様|もよう} (polka dot pattern) is often shortened to just {水玉|みずたま} when the context is clear. The literal meaning of water droplets is less common but still used poetically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水玉|みずたま}{模様|もよう} (polka dot pattern)
- {水玉|みずたま}の{服|ふく} (polka dot clothes)
- {大|おお}きな{水玉|みずたま} (large polka dots)
- {小|ちい}さな{水玉|みずたま} (small polka dots)
